annotations.title: Find the departure gate for a SkyLark flight to a given city

routine_tools.description: Find the departure gate for a SkyLark flight to a given city. App: SkyLark (com.skylark.air), on a phone Envoy operates. Open My Trips in SkyLark Air, select the trip to the requested destination city, and read the departure gate from the trip details screen. Outputs: gate (in get_task's result once it's done). Learned by Envoy from a run on Oct 27, 2026; replays without model calls while the app looks as it did; anything irreversible waits for the user's OK on their phone. Returns a task ID; follow it with get_task.

trip_city.description: The destination city of the flight, shown in the goal and matched against the trip rows in My Trips
